_note: Reader-selected wiki pages as question context (`context_paths`). NEW product, not a port: there is no legacy producer to record, so this fixture is a SPECIFICATION rather than a recording, and it says so. It exists because the rule set is implemented TWICE — in the Go sub-application host (services/elitea-subapp-host/internal/apps/deepwiki/run/contextpaths.go), which resolves in front of every tool table on that host, and in the Python service (services/elitea-deepwiki/src/elitea_deepwiki/wiki_context.py), which covers a sidecar called directly. Two implementations of a rule about what a client may make the server read is exactly the pair that must not drift, so both read this file.
